items.reason: Gap 0 describes two retries in the queue concurrently both seeing the id absent before either records it, so both process it.
Gap 2 says deduplication uses the unsigned X-Event-Id header instead of the signed body id, so a changed header defeats it.
Gap 3 says the provider sends charge.refunded while the refund handler is registered as refund.created, so the refund is lost.
No gap depends on multiple processes or replicas; the concurrency raised is among queue workers in one process.
